signals.text: 'He knows his role' - Rulli provides heroics but no worries for Donnarumma. Geronimo Rulli's penalty shootout heroics may have put the pressure on Gianluigi Donnarumma at Manchester City, but manager Enzo Maresca has no doubt about his number one.
Sesko ruled out until January with shin injury. Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko is expected to be out until at least January with a shin injury.

'Biggest night in club's history' for fearless Fleetwood. A whopping 83 league places separated Fleetwood from Arsenal, yet the hosts booked their place in the Carabao Cup quarter-final thanks to their penalty shootout win over the Gunners.
Unlucky seven? Wrexham aim to buck bizarre trend. Phil Parkinson hopes his Wrexham side can buck the trend of Championship teams struggling in seasons after finishing in seventh in the second tier.
